name: FGF Live Experiential Intelligence

core.purpose: canonical game knowledge and evidence-grounded answers

observation.purpose: direct gameplay observation and state/event capture

experience.purpose: learn patterns from repeated observations and outcomes

youtube.purpose: gap fallback and interpretation; never overrides core

rules: Core/canonical FGF knowledge is checked first.
Direct observation is evidence, not automatic canonical truth.
YouTube is fallback/enrichment only when core knowledge does not establish the requested information.
Learned experience is a candidate signal until repeated, comparable evidence validates it.
Higher-authority current evidence outranks lower-authority or stale evidence.
Conflicts are preserved and surfaced; never silently overwritten.
Every observation carries timestamp, session, game/version context when available, and provenance.
No unsupported numeric values, costs, timers, requirements, rewards, or mechanics may be invented.
User feedback is a learning signal, not factual proof.
Personal/player context may personalize recommendations but cannot rewrite global game truth.
The observer must fail closed: unknown screen/state becomes unknown, not a guessed fact.
The local observer enforces a maximum two-hour daily observation budget.

query_behavior.factual: core official/curated evidence only; abstain if not established
query_behavior.strategy: core facts first, then validated experience, then clearly-labelled community/YouTube fallback
query_behavior.interpretation: core facts plus clearly-labelled community/experience interpretation
query_behavior.ambiguous: ask only for context that can materially change the answer
